                                            Success Discover a world
                                            of academic resources, digital collections, and personalized support at
                                            Kampala University Library — your gateway to learning, research, and
                                            innovation. Explore. Learn. Achieve. With vast
                                            collections, quiet study spaces, and digital access anytime, the KU Library
                                            is here to support your academic journey every step of the way. Kampala University Library Monday - Friday 8:00 am to 9:00 pm Weekends 9:00 am to 5:00 pm Recess 8:00 am to 5:00 pm Public Holidays CLOSED Opening Hours Ask a Librarian library@ku.ac.ug About Us At the ground floor of the university building is the main library comprising of one section,
                            which is situated at Kampala University main Campus Ggaba. It has a seating capacity of One hundred users, over 32,000 print volumes, over 500 journal
                            titles, and over 900 dissertations. It has 20 computers all linked to the Internet. The
                            Wireless Internet coverage is also available in the Library, enabling students and staff
                            with wireless devices to access the internet while in the Library. read
                            more Resources List of our featured resources Institutional Repository Access a wide collection of research papers, theses, dissertations, and scholarly works authored by our university community.
